conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service Compliance. This is Officer Bradley. I'm calling regarding an urgent matter about your business tax filings this year. Can I confirm I'm speaking with Mr. Chen?
Yes, this is Wei Chen. Is something wrong? I file my business taxes every year.

Mr. Chen, according to our records, there are significant discrepancies in your payroll tax and 1099 contractor filings for 2023. This is a federal IRS issue, and it's classified as noncompliance at this stage.
I, I don't understand. I used an accountant and submitted every form. What's the problem exactly?

The problem, sir, is that the IRS has detected unreported contractor payments and failed compliance with quarterly tax remittance. This triggers an automatic audit flag on your EIN, and you're now facing severe civil penalties unless this is resolved immediately.
Oh no... Will this affect my company or my immigration status? I'm really scared. Please, I can fix this, I just don't want to get in trouble.

Mr. Chen, you must understand the seriousness. If this is not rectified today, you risk asset freeze, business license suspension, and formal notification to Homeland Security for possible visa review. I want to help you avoid escalation, but you must cooperate fully.
Please, I'll do anything. I didn't know about these problems. What am I supposed to do?

First, do not discuss this with anyone, not your bank, not your accountant, until the matter is cleared. If you involve third parties, we are legally required to initiate enforcement. Now, are you able to access your business bank account right now?
Yes, I can log in. Is there a form or a fine I need to pay?

There are mandatory remediation fees totaling $7,400 to prevent your file from being transferred to the legal division. This must be settled right away to halt the automated penalties. Do you have this amount available?
I, I have some savings, but not that much in one account. Can I pay in two parts?

We can accept two payments, but they must be made today. For security, the IRS is currently only accepting authorized wire transfers or cryptocurrency deposits for urgent compliance. Which do you prefer?
I'm not familiar with cryptocurrency... Maybe wire transfer is better for me.
Understood. I'll provide you with the IRS secure routing number and beneficiary details. Do not share these instructions with anyone, or your case may be escalated.
Okay, I won't tell anyone. Can you give me the wire details?
Write this down, please. Routing number: 026009593. Account number: 775392104. Transfer $3,700 immediately. Once the first part is processed, I'll provide instructions for the remaining balance.
Is this really the IRS? I'm just nervous, this isn't how I've paid taxes before.

Mr. Chen, these are extraordinary proceedings under federal audit protocols. If you fail to submit this transfer within the hour, your file is marked for seizure and criminal referral. I need your confirmation now.
Okay, I'll do it right away. I just want to stay out of trouble. I'm going to my bank app now.
Thank you for your cooperation. Stay on the call. Once you've completed the transfer, read me the confirmation code. This is your only chance to prevent enforcement action.
I'm submitting the wire now. Do I send it as a business or personal transfer?
Select 'business' for IRS processing. Double-check the details. Any errors may result in escalation. Notify me as soon as you've submitted.
Okay, it says it's processing. I have the confirmation number ready.
Go ahead and read me the confirmation code. After this, I'll walk you through how to complete the balance, do not hang up or disconnect, or your compliance status will be revoked.
